canon.note: Basic Starshine (120601) 140% of ATK at L10. Skill Mountainfall (120602) deals #1 = 210% (L10) Physical DMG to one enemy, with #3 = 33% chance to trigger Sword Stance on the final hit for #2 = 100% extra DMG; guaranteed on Weakness Broken targets. Ultimate Dawn Herald (120603) deals #1 = 320% (L10) DMG to one enemy, Sushang immediately takes action, ATK + #4 = 30% and 2 extra Sword Stance chances at #3 = 50% of original DMG for #2 = 2 turns. Talent Dancing Blade (120604): when an enemy is Weakness Broken on the field, SPD + #1 = 20% for #2 = 2 turns. Energy limit 120.

fixtures.env: Sushang E0 solo vs 3 Physical-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Mountainfall (120602) is Sushang's damaging Skill action.
Mountainfall delivers the 210% (L10) Skill multiplier as a 30/70 two-hit split per cast; the fixture's 5 casts (3 own + 2 post-Ultimate extra actions) produce 10 hits.
Sushang's Ultimate action is Dawn Herald (120603).
Dawn Herald hits the designated enemy once per Ultimate (2 Ultimates in the fixture).
Sushang's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; it never falls back to a generic attack action.
Talent Dancing Blade (120604) requires an enemy Weakness Broken on the field; the fixture never breaks one, so the SPD buff never applies.
Mountainfall L10 total = 210% of ATK (120602 #1); the first split part carries 30% → 0.63.
Mountainfall's second split part carries 70% of the 210% total → 1.47.
Dawn Herald (120603 #1) deals Physical DMG equal to 320% of ATK at L10 in a single hit.
Basic Starshine (120601) runs the 50%→140% ladder (L10 = 140%); at the engine's default Basic Lv6 it totals 100%.
Dawn Herald's ATK boost lasts #2 = 2 turns (120603).
Dawn Herald increases Sushang's ATK by #4 = 30% at L10 (120603).
Sushang's Ultimate uses the standard 120-Energy ladder (sp_need 120); over this fixture her action set regenerates exactly 215 Energy.
The post-Ultimate extra-action Skill's Sword Stance opportunities resolve only after Dawn Herald's damage (the buff window must be active first).
The Ultimate action starts before Dawn Herald damage resolves.
The extra action granted by Dawn Herald is a real Skill that spends Skill Points: 5 SP spent over the fixture (3 own Skill casts + 2 extra-action Skill casts).
While Dawn Herald is active, Skill gains 2 extra Sword Stance chances dealing 50% of the original DMG (120603 #3) — observed as the extra-chance Additional DMG event.
